source.authoredBasis: Authored from the complete tasks, not a source scan. A plots 2^x with readable increments; B plots 2^x solid and 1.5^x dashed. C plots 2^x solid with y=2 dashed; D plots (1/2)^x solid with y=1/2 dashed. Bases 2 and 1/2 are explicitly representative for the two regimes in 693, not new source givens. No solutions or intersections are annotated.

notes: Four complete panels A-D. A: increasing convex base-2 curve on x=0..3, half-unit grid, all requested increment intervals inside the window. B: base-2 solid and base-1.5 dashed in one frame, common ordinate at zero and reversed ordering on the two sides. C/D: exponential versus its base-height horizontal line in the increasing/decreasing regimes; crossing aligned with x=1. Axes, rightmost x=3 and final D bottom labels are visible. Every emitted polyline vertex was inverse-mapped from screen coordinates to the independently assigned axes and evaluated against its written formula; hidden sample assertions alone were not treated as curve proof. Both constant lines and all grid dimensions/labels were also checked. Representative bases for 693 are disclosed, not substituted as universal source givens. Full image actually viewed once; visible labels are English/numerical, no cultural marks, solutions or correct-option annotations. Neutral semantic SVG colors and clear strokes. Scratch-path packaging is pending the parent, not a second mathematical gate.
